note: Eye check: the trunks leave the red family. Sampled on the crown_arch trunks, the dark-red trunk right of the arch goes from RGB 86,31,35 to 85,89,106 (red 4 below green) and the left trunk from 107,50,71 to 105,104,138 (red 1 above green, level within a step); blue now leads, so the bark reads cool silver to lavender-grey under the lilac light, on every frame. Red-leading pixels per frame fall 0.055-0.158 to 0.012-0.054 (what stays is the pink creatures, the trainer, the red flag at glass_field and the amber road vein, which the arm does not touch). Foliage unchanged: mean RGB of green-dominant pixels equal within 1 level on all four frames. vegetation.gd also folds foliage_grade_1104 into a loop; the foliage check covers it.
